coso_tooltips.p1: Organization demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.
coso_tooltips.p2: Board of Directors demonstrates independence from management and exercises oversight of the development and performance of internal control.
coso_tooltips.p3: Management establishes, with board oversight, structures, reporting lines, and appropriate authorities and responsibilities in the pursuit of objectives.
coso_tooltips.p4: Organization demonstrates a commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals in alignment with objectives.
coso_tooltips.p5: Organization holds individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities in the pursuit of objectives.
coso_tooltips.p6: Organization specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable the identification and assessment of risks relating to objectives.
coso_tooltips.p7: Organization identifies risks to the achievement of its objectives across the entity and analyzes risks as a basis for determining how the risks should be managed.
coso_tooltips.p8: Organization considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks to the achievement of objectives.
coso_tooltips.p9: Organization identifies and assesses changes that could significantly impact the system of internal control.
coso_tooltips.p10: Organization selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to the achievement of objectives to acceptable levels.
coso_tooltips.p11: Organization selects and develops general control activities over technology to support the achievement of objectives.
coso_tooltips.p12: Organization deploys control activities through policies that establish what is expected and procedures that put policies into action.
coso_tooltips.p13: Organization obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information to support the functioning of internal control.
coso_tooltips.p14: Organization internally communicates information, including objectives and responsibilities for internal control, necessary to support the functioning of internal control.
coso_tooltips.p15: Organization communicates with external parties regarding matters affecting the functioning of internal control.
coso_tooltips.p16: Organization selects, develops, and performs ongoing and/or separate evaluations to ascertain whether the components of internal control are present and functioning.
coso_tooltips.p17: Organization evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies in a timely manner to those parties responsible for taking corrective action.

domains.access: Controls over the provision of access rights to the IT environment (applications, databases, operating systems, networks and tools) only to authorized users.
domains.development: Controls to ensure that each development/acquisition of system/application has gone through at least the request, development/acquisition, testing, and implementation process approved by the authorities.
domains.changes: Controls to ensure that every change to system/application, data and related infrastructure components has gone through at least the request, testing and implementation process approved by the authorities.
domains.operations: Controls to ensure that systems/applications process data completely and accurately, and ensure that identified incidents and problems have been resolved completely and accurately.
